_comment: Inputs for scripts/gen_model.py. Body axes: x forward, y left, z up; origin at the CAD origin (frame centre). Re-run gen_model.py after editing.

frame._source: ROS/EMSD cad/mass_properties.json (QAV-RXL2 CAD; frame, arms, motors, Pi, FC, ESC and wiring)
frame._cad_to_body: The real front is CAD -y, so body = CAD rotated +90 deg about z (confirmed by the team 2026-11-08)

battery._source: Team measurement 2026-11-08 (6S 12000 mAh). Mass to be re-measured; 1.58 kg also quoted.
battery._mount: on top of the frame, long side front to back

motors._source_layout: Motor positions from EMSD drone.json, rotated to body axes. Spin from companion/README.md (verified 2026-10-26). Outputs from FC log 00016 (SERVO1..4_FUNCTION = 36,33,34,35).
motors._source_curve: ROS/EMSD motor_data.xlsx (sheet MQ1053B_6s_StepsTest_thrust_1_r, DShot300, ~24.7 V); fits in sim/README.md
motors._speed_map: rad/s = speed_per_cmd * (cmd + speed_offset), cmd = (PWM-1000)/1000; linear fit of the DC-motor model over cmd 0.15-0.95
motors._max_torque: torque at the bench test's top point: 2.0 kgf at 34.5 A (DShot 1500). The team confirms ~2 kg per motor at ~35 A is the real maximum, so the motor torque is capped here (a current limit); outputs above ~0.73 give no more thrust.
motors._time_constant: assumed (not resolved by the bench test); typical for 8 inch props

aero._comment: Blade-element constants for Gazebo's LiftDrag system; gen_model.py sizes blade area and drag to hit thrust_coeff and torque_coeff.
